svg.text: MIPS_proc datapath — 5 stages, forwarding, two-level branch prediction

Every box is a Verilog module in src/. Blue = forward datapath, red = values fed backwards, orange = branch prediction and its update, purple = hazard control. I2C programming is in the system diagram in README.md.
write_data — register-file write, and the MEM/WB forward

instruction_memory is addressed with PC_next, one cycle early, so the BSRAM’s 1-cycle latency costs the pipeline nothing. The load result skips MEM/WB entirely: data_memory’s own output register is that stage.
